nodes.title: How to use - tested on RTX 3060
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

1. **Pick a MODE**:

| Mode | Uses | How it runs |
|---|---|---|
| T2V | prompt | two stages (half size, then 2x upscale) |
| I2V (first frame) | First frame | two stages |
| First + last frame | First + Last frame | one stage, 1280x720 guides |
| Pose control (IC-LoRA Union) | First frame (your character) + Pose video | pose is extracted with SDPose; the IC-LoRA was made for LTX 2.3 and runs on 2.5 |

2. Write the prompt (include sounds), set length + size, press **Run**.

Core ComfyUI 0.37.4 nodes only. Times on the RTX 3060 are in the repo README.
